faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate-I – Plasma Process Modeling post at IIT Gandhinagar is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc. or equivalent in an appropriate discipline, or a B.Sc. or equivalent with at least 4 years of post-qualification experience. A minimum of 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in 10th and 12th are also required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 80,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-I – Plasma Process Modeling post at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official IIT Gandhinagar website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Research Associate-I – Plasma Process Modeling is a contractual job.

faq.answer: The selection process typically involves application screening, shortlisting of candidates, and potentially a selection test or interview.
